description: Performs ground plane intersection with bounding box detections to estimate 3D pose of detected objects

camera_intrinsics_path.description: Path to camera intrinsics JSON file, or camera bus ID (e.g., '0', '0-1') to auto-resolve path

camera_height.description: Height of camera above ground plane in meters

camera_pitch.description: Pitch angle of camera in radians (positive = looking down)

frame_width.description: Width of input frames (if None, will try to get from intrinsics)

frame_height.description: Height of input frames (if None, will try to get from intrinsics)
